Name: Sans in the Saloon
Author: c6h11OH
Description:
Sans Undertale can now be chilling in your Stardew Valley world!

This is my first proper mod and also a practice run for a more ambitious NPC project (though that one's one big inside joke, so I probably won't post it) - so it's quite rudimentary. However, it DOES feature:

-Around ~60-70 lines of dialogue, getting friendlier as you increase his heart level!
-A couple custom gift reactions!
-Tiny little pieces of lore implications...?
-Janky sprites and just sort of okay portraits!

And... that's kind of it! But he's nice to just have around, you know? You'll probably forget he's even there.

NOTE: Sans uses the wrong portrait in two of his dialogues because I got the numbers mixed up... I have a bigger update in the works so that will be fixed then, but for now know this: if he goes blue eye on you, he doesn't mean it, he's meant to be doing something else there.


There are some remnants of things in the files for the events I was going to write but didn't end up doing. I don't know if I'll come back to this, but that'll be my priority if I do! 

If you want to add your own events and/or dialogue, feel free. (I mean, I can't really stop you from modifying your personal files.) Note about the sprites, though - I didn't add the necessary sprites for a walk cycle, so if you get Sans to move anywhere, he's just going to slide. Originally I was going to have him warp around if he needed to move locations...

Sans is owned by Toby Fox. I drew all his sprites and portraits, but they're directly referenced from his in-game assets.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and place in mods folder.

Manifest.Description: Adds Sans Undertale as an giftable NPC that stands in the back room of the Saloon.
